apps.localizedDescription:
Arc TV downloads:

Builds and update feeds for Arc TV on Mac, Android and iPhone/iPad. The Mac app is the main app; Android and iPhone are in early access. The app itself lives in a private repository; this one only holds what the apps need to update themselves.

Arc TV is a free player for the live TV, movies and series from your own IPTV provider. It does not include any channels or playlists.

Arc TV 2.0:

Arc TV 2.0 helps you find something to watch, and makes your data safe to move between devices.

• Browse by genre (Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android). Filter your matched movies and series by genre. The Mac also filters by decade, rating and language.

versions.localizedDescription:
Arc TV 2.6.0 for iPhone and iPad:

• One card per title. Movies show a title once with "N versions" and a version picker. Search forgives typos, so "dhurandar" finds Dhurandhar.
• Fix match. A wrong poster or description can be corrected from the detail page.
• Restore keeps your place. A Mac backup brings back all your positions and Continue Watching fills in the background.
• Live TV. Rows show what is on now, with a guide on iPad and in iPhone landscape and a channel list inside the player.
• Calmer with the portal. Far fewer requests at launch and restore. If the portal refuses, the app waits, says so plainly with Retry, and stays quiet in the background.
• Fixes. Remove source and Clear history ask first and work. iPad has a search field. Home screen quick actions and a Resume shortcut.
